description: An AI-powered customer communications platform combining a modern business phone system, shared inbox, SMS/WhatsApp, and voice/messaging AI agents.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 auth code flow for public marketplace apps; HTTP Basic Authentication using API ID and API Token for private/customer apps.
credential_notes: API access requires a paid subscription tier (Professional plan or higher includes full API access), though a trial or free access entry is available to test the platform.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering calls, users, teams, conversations, conversation intelligence (transcripts, summaries, sentiment, CSAT), SMS/WhatsApp messaging, outbound campaigns, webhooks, and analytics reports.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by the vendor yet; documentation mentions AI integration concepts but does not provide an official MCP package.
rationale: Aircall provides a robust, fully documented REST API and webhooks, but full API access requires a paid plan tier (Professional or higher).

evidence.note: Details OAuth for technology partners and Basic Auth (api_id and api_token) for customers.
Shows pricing plans, indicating full API access is included in Professional and Enterprise tiers.
Comprehensive API reference covering users, calls, conversations, intelligence, messaging, and webhooks.
Developer home page listing available tools (REST API, Webhooks, SDK, MCP mentions coming soon).
